contract: TASK-120 integration key, lifecycle and cursor (plan §5.2, D5, S5, SN4, SN7, FN2)
key_format: kapit_ic_<prefix:8 chars [a-z0-9]>_<secret: >=256 bits from secrets, urlsafe>
key_digest: HMAC-SHA256(derive(SECRET_KEY, 'kapit-integration-key-v1'), key); only the digest is stored
transport: Authorization: Bearer only; no query-string key; no session auth; GET only (other methods 405, no side effect)

lifecycle.REDUCED_or_SUMMARY: request and collect in one transaction by the requester
lifecycle.FULL: request -> approval by a different INTEGRATION holder -> collect by the requester only, once
lifecycle.collect: secret generated only at collect under the organization lock; refused after collect_deadline (<= 24 h) or expires_at; requester and approver authority and active administrator role re-checked
lifecycle.issuer_revocation: a key outlives later revocation of its issuer's authority; it stops only by key revocation or expiry

auth_failure_audit_prefix: recorded only if it matches ^[a-z0-9]{8}$, otherwise no value

cursor.scope_epochs_digest_FN2: digest of sorted [[unit_id, scope_epoch], ...] for every unit sourcing the client's channel at issue time; any change -> INVALID_CURSOR
cursor.errors: tampered, expired, cross-client or epoch-mismatched -> 400 INVALID_CURSOR

page.ordering: (published_at DESC, id DESC) on stored exact values
page.items: exactly serialize_publication output for the matching recipient
